chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Hammad ibn Isa, from Hariz, from Zurara, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:

Say: O Allah, I ask You from every goodness of which Your Knowledge is encompassing, and I seek Refuge with You from every evil of which Your Knowledge is encompassing. O Allah, I ask You for Your well-being in all my affairs, and I seek Refuge with You from the disgrace of the world and the punishment of the Hereafter.
ai.seo_question: What is the comprehensive supplication for seeking all goodness and refuge from all evil according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Recorded in al-Kafi, this supplication from Imam al-Baqir (AS) encapsulates the Shia tradition of comprehensive du'a by linking divine omniscience ('ahata bihi 'ilmuhu) to the believer's specific needs for 'afiyah (well-being) and protection from dunya's disgrace. It serves as a concise yet profound model for integrating worldly stability with spiritual salvation, reflecting the Imams' emphasis on holistic divine care.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Hammad Bin Isa, from Hareyz, from Zurara, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘

Say, ‘O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! I ask You<sup>azwj</sup> from every goodness Your<sup>azwj</sup> Knowledge is Encompassing with, and I seek Refuge with You<sup>azwj</sup> from every evil Your<sup>azwj</sup> Knowledge is Encompassing with. O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! I ask You<sup>azwj</sup> for Your<sup>azwj</sup> good health to be in my life-time, all of it, and I seek Refuge with You<sup>azwj</sup> from every disgrace of the world and the Punishment of the Hereafter’’.
en.sarwar: 3. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from Hammad ibn ‘Isa from Hariz from Zurara from abu Ja’far (a.s.) who has said the following: “

O Lord, I plead to receive from You (my share of) all good which Your knowledge encompasses, I seek protection with You against all evil which is encompassed by Your knowledge, O Lord, I plead before You for good health from You in all of my affairs, I seek protection with You against losses in this world and the torment of the next life.”
